page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.32xlarge is an enterprise-scale, general-purpose cloud instance built on x86_64 architecture and deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The host utilizes Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a sustained base frequency of 3.2 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is configured at 512.0 GB, providing an even 4.0 GB per vCPU to meet standard enterprise capacity demands. The hardware configuration omits discrete GPU acceleration, focusing entirely on multi-core central processing capabilities.

For connectivity, the ecs.g9i.32xlarge features a baseline network bandwidth of 36 Gbps to facilitate heavy inter-node data exchange. It carries no bundled local disk storage, which means stateful operations rely entirely on remote network-attached block volumes. Furthermore, the configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring dedicated routing infrastructure or elastic IP allocation for Internet-facing services.

Without onboard storage or accelerator silicon, resource economics favor deployments that maximize simultaneous core utilization and memory footprint without incurring GPU-related overhead. The server delivers reliable compute density for environments prioritizing isolation and consistent multi-threaded execution. Typical enterprise deployments include high-throughput web service fleets, distributed data processing nodes, large in-memory caches, and continuous integration compilation clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.32xlarge is an enterprise-grade general-purpose virtual machine based on x86_64 architecture and KVM virtualization. The system is powered by Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This establishes a balanced allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or bundled local storage, directing all disk I/O operations across network-attached block volumes. Networking capabilities feature a baseline throughput of 36 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default. Due to its dense core count and substantial memory profile, the ecs.g9i.32xlarge is well structured for large-scale enterprise applications, high-concurrency microservices, in-memory caching tiers, distributed data processing, and large build automation pipelines.
